mainText: Good morning, Bryan. Today's verse is Isaiah chapter 30, verse 15: For thus saith the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength. Notice the word returning. You are in the last stretch of a review season in the sky, when the work is to go back, look again, and finish what you started, not push something brand new through the door. Your strength today does not come from hurrying. It comes from the quiet confidence of someone who has done this work with his hands for eighteen years and knows how good it is. Go back to the idea you set aside, the client you have not heard from, the note you meant to finish, and give it your calm attention. Steady, unhurried care is what heals people at the clinic, and it is what will heal and grow the business too. Let us pray. Lord, thank you for this new morning and for the work you have placed in my hands. Teach me the strength of quietness and the wisdom of returning. Help me tend what you have already given me with patience and gratitude, and trust you with what is still unfolding. Amen.

Today is a special day. Mercury and Venus are both about to turn direct on Friday, so Tuesday through Thursday are for finishing the review. Double check billing, insurance claims and agreements before Friday. Look again at your pricing and what you offer, decide this week, and act after Friday. Back up your files, and reconnect with past clients and referral partners. Tonight, write three loose ends on a card, close one before bed, and set the card under a plant in your southeast corner. The Moon is a fresh waxing crescent in Sagittarius, and around eleven this morning it crosses your natal Mars, bringing a lift in courage and drive. The headline is Uranus sitting right on your natal Mercury: sudden ideas, tech breakthroughs, and new ways to communicate. Write every flash of insight down. Venus is in an easy trine to your Gemini Sun and Moon, so conversations with clients and collaborators flow warmly. Your personal day number is six, the number of service, care and healing. Look after the people who depend on you, and include yourself. On the emotional scale, today may start with a little impatience. Reach for hopefulness with this thought: I do not have to figure it all out today. The threads are already coming together.

Your tarot card today is the Page of Cups, reversed. Upright, a young messenger stands by the sea holding a golden cup with a little fish peeking out, the card of a surprising idea and a creative spark. Reversed, the message is still tender, an idea that is not quite ready yet, or a whisper of self doubt about something you care about. An idea for the clinic or your consulting is still incubating. Do not force it out before Friday, and do not dismiss it. Treat it like the fish in the cup: small, alive, and needing a little more water. Your oracle card is The Weaver: your threads are becoming a tapestry. Your healing hands, your tech knowledge, your community, your faith and your daily practices can look scattered up close. Step back and a pattern is forming. Keep weaving, one thread at a time.

Your color today is turquoise, the stone of the Sagittarius Moon. It blends calm water with open sky. Wear it, carry it in your pocket, or drink your morning coffee from a turquoise mug. For feng shui, face southeast, your personal growth direction, whenever you sit down to plan, write or do the books. One small change: clear the southeast corner of your desk or treatment room and place a healthy green plant there, or refresh the one already there. Living wood energy feeds steady growth.

Say this out loud, with your whole body in it: I return with confidence. I finish what I start. Every thread I weave makes my work stronger and my life richer. Your inspired action today: send one warm, simple hello to a past client or referral partner you have not spoken with in a while, and spend ten minutes backing up your important files before Friday. Your question to carry today: what idea have I been holding in my cup that only needs a little more patience and care before it is ready to share? Have a beautiful day, Bryan.
